value.rationale: The zero-forcing and zero-damping slice is the canonical Hamiltonian boundary of the 2023 exponential Duffing model and beta is its actual introduced parameter. The finding fully determines all bounded complete motions, invariant probability measures and the codimension-one restoration/destruction of an entire family of periodic cylinders, rather than computing one arbitrary orbit. Exact heteroclinic scattering shifts have sharply asymmetric exponential versus reciprocal-beta scaling, quantitative dynamical data for future forced perturbations. Does not project this boundary conclusion to the source chaotic regime.
